briefing: Stocks rose across the board today, with the NASDAQ up 1.8% and the S&P 500 up 1.4%, a clear risk-on day. The portfolio is up 47.9% with 7 positions and about $446 in cash, just under the usual $500 buy threshold. Because the day was risk-on and 3 slots are open, we made one small medium-conviction buy of NU, the top-scoring candidate, and left the existing positions to their automatic profit targets and stop-losses.

daily_lesson.explanation_en: A risk-on day is when investors feel confident and move money into riskier assets like growth and tech stocks, which pushes major indexes up together. Today both the NASDAQ and the S&P 500 rose more than 1%, and tech led the way, which is a typical risk-on pattern. On days like this, momentum strategies tend to put spare cash to work instead of holding it.
daily_lesson.explanation_zh: 所謂「風險偏好」（Risk-On），是指投資者信心增強，資金流向科技股、成長股等較高風險資產，令主要指數同步走高。今日納指及標普500同告升逾1%，並由科技股領漲，屬典型的風險偏好行情。在這類交易日，動能策略一般會把閒置資金投入市場，而非持幣觀望。

market_education.summary_en: Buyers were confident across the market today: the NASDAQ rose 1.8% and the S&P 500 rose 1.4%. Chip, storage and AI-infrastructure stocks led the move, with names like MU, SNDK, STX, LITE and DELL showing bullish MACD crossovers and trading above their 20-day averages. No specific news headlines were provided today, so this explanation is based only on price and momentum data, not on a particular news event.
market_education.summary_zh: 今日市場風險胃納明顯回升，納斯達克指數上揚1.8%，標普500指數亦升1.4%。半導體、儲存及AI基建板塊領漲，美光（MU）、SanDisk（SNDK）、希捷（STX）、Lumentum（LITE）及戴爾（DELL）等個股的MACD均出現黃金交叉，股價亦企穩20日均線之上。由於今日未有提供具體新聞標題，以上分析僅以價格及動能數據為依據，並非歸因於特定消息。
